# gravity_role_discovery (Resource)

Configuration of the discovery role.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gravity_role_discovery" "discovery" {
  enabled = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Role configurations are singletons, identified by the role name
terraform import gravity_role_discovery.discovery 'discovery'
```
